exempleA11y: Sample data, until the server is ready

vide.titre: Your progress will show up here
vide.texte: Add a first test result (MAS, jump, sprint, 1RM…) or finish a session: you will see your results, your records and your consistency.

etats.horsLigneSection: Not loaded yet: it will show up as soon as you're back online.
etats.horsLigneTexte: This data will show up as soon as you're online.

records.videTexte: Your records and milestones will show up here, dated, as soon as you achieve them in a session or a test.

tests.videTexte: Add a test result (MAS, jump, sprint, 1RM…) to track your progress.
tests.sensHaut: For this test, the higher the value, the better.
tests.sensBas: For this test, the lower the value, the better.
tests.validite_one: A result stays valid for {{count}} day.
tests.validite_other: A result stays valid for {{count}} days.
tests.e1rmTexte: Estimated by the server from your logged sets.
tests.introuvableTexte: Add a result to start the curve.

ajout.erreurTypes: Couldn't load the list of tests.
ajout.methodeAide: Tested: you did the test. Declared: a value you already know.

erreurs.date: Enter a valid date, today or earlier.

charge.insuffisant: Not enough sessions yet to compare with your usual load.
charge.insuffisantJours_one: Not enough data yet: {{count}} active day out of the last 28.
charge.insuffisantJours_other: Not enough data yet: {{count}} active days out of the last 28.
charge.legende: One bar per week; the last one is the current week.
charge.legendeZone: One bar per week; the last one is the current week. The band shows your optimal zone.
charge.resume: Load over the last {{nombre}} weeks, from {{premiere}} to {{derniere}} this week.
charge.explicationCharge: A session's load is its duration multiplied by how hard it felt (RPE). It is counted in arbitrary units (AU).
charge.acwrTexte: Compares your last 7 days with your weekly average over the last 4 weeks ({{chronique}}). Around 1: you are training as usual.
charge.monotonieTexte: Shows how similar your load is from one day to the next: the higher the number, the more alike your days are.
charge.videTexte: Your load will show up after your first sessions logged with how hard they felt.

niveaux.explication: Your result compared with athletes of the same level, age, sex and sport. "Better than 70%": you beat 70% of them.
niveaux.manquantes: Test to find out your level
niveaux.videTexte: Do a test (MAS, jump, sprint…) to see where you stand among athletes like you.

regularite.nouvelleSerie: Your next successful week starts a new streak.
regularite.taux28: Sessions done over the last 28 days: {{taux}}%
regularite.videTexte: Your consistency will show up at the end of your first programme week.

ligues.regle: Rankings on your performance only, never on body weight or training volume.
ligues.choix: Leagues are optional: only join the ones you care about.
ligues.videTexte: Suggested leagues and challenges will show up here.
ligues.indisponibleTexte: Leagues and rankings are for ages 15 and up.
